targets.query:
from(bucket:"mybucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_server_requests_seconds_count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (exists r.method && r.method == "POST") && (exists r.uri && r.uri == "/test"))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean)
  |> yield(name: "rps")

from(bucket:"mybucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_server_requests_seconds_max")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (exists r.method && r.method == "POST") && (exists r.uri && r.uri == "/test"))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value * 1000.0 }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: max)
  |> yield(name: "max_ms")

from(bucket:"mybucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_server_requests_seconds_count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.status)
  |> group(columns: ["status"]) 
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: sum)
  |> yield(name: "by_status")
